notes:
Lead: CTO + Product. Mid-market analytics SaaS building in-app assistance and smart search. Started with Hosted API POC (Jan-Feb 2026) to validate ranking/embeddings quality, now moving to Dedicated/VPC for PII-sensitive logs.

POC highlights:
- Ran 2-week Hosted API POC with embeddings + reranking on 25k documents. Observed: embedding throughput ~120 QPS, median latency 60ms, 95th pct chat latency ~180ms for longer contexts.
- Quality: reranking uplift ~18% vs current BM25 on internal eval set.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay premium for reliability but needs clear committed pricing for Dedicated.

Security review status:
- SOC2 Type II required (legal says must be in contract). Redwood SOC2 doc is acceptable but legal wants date of last audit and scoping notes.
- Must support SSO (SAML) and SCIM for user provisioning.
- Audit logs retention: want 2 years by default, 7-year retention option for compliance team.
- KMS integration required for customer-managed keys.
- Data residency: primary data must remain in us-east-1, with audit trail proving no egress to other regions.

Quotes from calls:
- "We can't ship the in-app assistant to enterprise customers until Dedicated + VPC is approved" — CTO (2026-02-10).
- "Latency p95 target for chat must be <= 150ms after Dedicated optimizations; if not, we'll explore colocated inference options." — Head of Infra.

Technical preferences and constraints:
- Prefer Redwood-verified open models (quantized variants) or ability to bring our own model artifacts.
- Want automatic routing/fallback: primary model for quality, smaller quantized variant for burst or degraded capacity.
- Need prefix caching and session-aware KV caching to hit latency goals.
- Network: will require VPC peering with strict IP allowlist and egress controls; security team will provide SSO/SP metadata after NDA.

Commercials & POC plan:
- Current POC cost tracked under Hosted credits. If Dedicated pricing acceptable, propose 12-month reserved commit with burst credits.
- Next commercial ask: get Dedicated pricing addendum with clear unit economics (cost per 1M tokens, cache sizing, burst pricing).

Notes for AE/SE:
- Send SOC2 audit date and control scope to legal (drive doc linked).
- Book technical deep-dive with infra + networking to run VPC peering checklist.
- Prepare a short canary rollout plan and SLOs to present to product/ops on next call.
